description: A React component for selecting multiple channels with async loading, custom rendering, and icons, used in Mattermost web application.

classes.name: ChannelsInput
classes.description: A React component class for multi-channel input with async loading and custom rendering.

methods.name: getOptionValue
methods.description: Returns the ID of a channel for use as the option value.

methods.name: handleInputChange
methods.description: Handles input change events, including blur and menu close actions.

methods.name: optionsLoader
methods.description: Loads channel options asynchronously based on input value.

methods.name: loadingMessage
methods.description: Renders a loading spinner with localized message.

methods.name: NoOptionsMessage
methods.description: Custom message component when no options are available.

methods.name: formatOptionLabel
methods.description: Formats how each channel option is displayed, including icons.

methods.name: onChange
methods.description: Handles selection changes, passing selected channels upward.

methods.name: MultiValueRemove
methods.description: Custom component for removing selected options.

methods.name: onFocus
methods.description: Handles focus event to trigger input change.
